text:
liam_procurement: Hey team — vendor (Zenex) just updated ETAs. They pushed our mid-May H100 topoff 2-week out. Anyone on call for a quick sync?

sophia_ops: Ugh. Which PO? Do we have allocations we can re-route from other regions?

liam_procurement: PO# 45321 (EU reserved batch). Original ETA 2024-05-08, now 2024-05-22. Zenex says customs backlog + QA hold. They offered partial airlift for 8 units at +12% freight.

alex_infra: We have a scheduled rollout for eu-west-1 on 2024-05-10 that needs at least 6 H100s. If we miss that window, SLOs will be impacted. Can we accept partial airlift?

devon_logistics: Partial airlift sounds OK. Need confirmation on AWB and RMA overlay in case units arrive DOA. Ask Zenex about expedited DOA replacement SLA and whether they include return labels.

vendor_rep_zenex: Hi all — confirmed: we can airlift 8 units on MD-204 on 2024-05-14, freight +12%. DOA policy: 72-hour swap with prepaid return label to our EU depot. We can provide serials 48h before ship.

sophia_ops: @vendor_rep_zenex Can you share the depot address and a sample return label template? Also confirm if insurance covers thermal damage in transit.

vendor_rep_zenex: Depot: Zenex EU Depot, NL-AMS-DC-3. Insurance: yes, carriage insurance up to invoice value included for airlift. Return label template: attached (link) — we'll push to the portal.

liam_procurement: Pricing check: vendor quotes +12% freight. Our finance contact needs a line item. Devon, can you draft a quick cost delta? Rough calc: unit freight baseline €1,500 -> +12% -> €1,680 per unit, so 8 units delta ~€1,440.

devon_logistics: Yep that's right. Also add expedited handling fee of €400 and AWB surcharge €80 each. Total incremental ~€2,000. I'll attach a short PO amendment.

alex_infra: Longer-term question: can we swap capacity from apac pool? Are there 6 spare H100s in apac that can be reassigned and ship from there faster?

vendor_rep_zenex: APAC pools are separate contracts; we have 4 spare in APAC warehouse available for immediate release, but transfer to EU takes ~10 days + customs. Not faster than airlift.

sophia_ops: Ok. For risk mitigation: propose we accept 8-unit airlift, require Zenex to commit to immediate swap and provide prepaid RMA labels. Also request that any DOA beyond 72h they escalate to a depot replacement within 48h.

liam_procurement: I'll push amendment: 8-unit airlift, freight +12%, Zenex prepaid RMA labels, DOA swap SLA 72h, depot replacement escalation 48h. Approvals needed from finance and legal.

srebot: [deploy-bot] Note: if rollout is delayed, eu-west-1 queue will auto-scale capacity to fallback-model (gptx-small) after 72 hours. Consider canary target adjustments.

sophia_ops: Good note. @alex_infra please adjust canary to use fallback-model at 60h to be safe.

alex_infra: Will do. I'll update the rollout config and set alerting on queuing latency at +10%.

devon_logistics: Liam — I'll prepare PO amendment and RMA addendum, share in channel when ready. ETA 2 hours.

liam_procurement: Thanks. If Zenex can get serials 48h before ship that's ideal — we'll pre-stage depot intake and QA. :thumbsup: 

vendor_rep_zenex: Serial list will be sent to liam_procurement@redwood.io by 2024-05-12 14:00 CET. We'll also upload return label files to the portal.

sophia_ops: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene if anything changes. :raised_hands:
